description: Rename a folder, change its description, or move it under a different parent folder. Works on all three folder types: per-project Test Cases (default) and Test Runs trees, and the organization-level Modules tree. Moves of test-cases/test-runs folders require project_id; module folders need none.

parent_folder_id.description: Move under this folder (ULID), or pass "root" to make it a top-level folder; cannot be the folder itself or one of its descendants

project_id.description: Project ID (ULID) — required when moving a test-cases or test-runs folder; not used for modules

tree.description: Which folder tree the folder belongs to (default test-cases). "modules" is organization-level.

name: tm_update_folder
title: Update Folder
